bull_bear.body:
- Steel price volatility — Management states the company's risk "consists principally of fluctuating steel price", and separately flags "spiraling steel ... prices" as a factor that could affect the business environment. As a manufacturer of supplied equipment, steel is a direct input cost the company does not appear to hedge.
- Power and energy cost — Power charges are named by management as one of the three principal risks, and "spiraling ... energy prices" are flagged as a threat to the business environment.
- Trade receivable recoverability — "Trade recoverable" is named by management as one of the three principal risks of the company; periodic monitoring and evaluation are stated as the mitigation.
- Inflationary pressure on the business environment — Management describes the macroeconomic and industry outlook as stable and positive but qualifies it: "higher inflationary pressures, etc. could affect the business environment".
